releaseBoundary: This manually pinned primary-source security baseline is not a live updater. Refresh checkedAt, versions, securityFixCount and reference on the day of every public Direct release. A securityFixCount of 0 means the official post had not enumerated fixes, not that there were no fixes. This names the current widely deployed M156 stable floor; same-train version comparison is not a source review for another Chromium branch.
policy: As verified 2026-10-28, the current macOS Desktop Stable floor is Chromium 156.0.8078.74, published 2026-10-27. The official post lists .73/.74 for Windows and Mac and .73 for Linux; its security changes are not yet enumerated. The NeAntik runtime must be built from the pinned official stable source at or above the macOS floor. A limited Early Stable rollout remains separate and is not the widely deployed floor. Cross-branch runtime use still requires source-bound review.
